svg.title: SOTIF scenes: one card per SOTIF hazard (WP-C-05, WP-C-06)
svg.desc: 13 cards, one per SOTIF hazard of WP-C-05 §3. SH-01 Leaves the lane on a false line: TC-05 via FI-01 (P), Needs validation. SH-02 Runs wide in a tight curve: TC-14 via FI-11 (S), Needs modification (ODD bound + authority characterisation). SH-03 Auto-resumes into a crossing pedestrian: TC-27 via FI-12 (S), Needs modification. SH-04 Phantom braking under a gantry: TC-10 via FI-06 (P), Needs validation. SH-05 Gas override does not disengage: TC-29 via FI-21 (S), Needs validation (HMI clinic). SH-06 Lead brakes harder than the bound: TC-33 via FI-10 (S), Needs validation (driver responsibility; user info). SH-08 Stock PCS braking delayed: TC-34 via FI-23 (S), Needs validation. SH-09 Drives through a red light: TC-13 via FI-05 (P), Needs modification. SH-10 Lane change into an occupied lane: TC-28 via FI-13 (S), Acceptable with user info (driver-initiated, abortable); needs validation of abort controllability. SH-11 No reaction to a pedestrian: TC-12 via FI-04 (P), Needs modification (ODD restricted to highways, DQ-023: a VRU in or near the lane is rare there and stays a driver responsibility; user info). SH-12 Inattention reset by small inputs: TC-25 via FI-19 (S), Needs modification. SH-13 Stays engaged above the ODD speed: TC-20 via FI-16 (S), Needs modification. SH-14 Does not move over for a stopped patrol car: TC-36 via FI-24 (S), Needs validation (driver responsibility; user info).
svg.text: SOTIF scenes · one card per SOTIF hazard
Nothing fails: a triggering condition exposes an insufficiency of the intended function. Chart over the scene, seen from above.

P: performance insufficiency, the blue layer is what the camera or radar believes. S: specification insufficiency, the chart sets the need against what the specification delivers. Each scene loops; the plant runs are in assurance/sim §3.7.
